producer: fixtures/parity/tiny-gpt2/model.lock.json pins the revision and every file digest
note: This is the only file CI reads to decide whether a model-dependent lane may run. status must be 'pinned', revision must be the 40-hex commit the model lock names, and fixtures_manifest_sha256 must match the bytes of fixtures_manifest, so a lock that changed without a new pin is refused instead of silently trusted. While status is 'unpinned' the lane reports NOT VERIFIED. Run 'python3 tools/ci/model_pin.py seal' after editing fixtures_manifest.
